queries.query: The test suite passes locally but test_checkout fails in CI about once every few runs. Figure out why.
SyncClient.list_stations() returns 200 stations when the network has 250. Why?
Our nightly export started producing empty CSV files last week and nothing in the code changed. Can you find out what's going on?
Why does the app log me out every time I switch tabs? It started after the last deploy.
Fix the typo 'recieve' in README.md.
Add a --json flag to the weatherkit CLI list command.
Checkout is returning 500s for every customer in production right now. What do we do first?
Rename the function parse_station to parse_station_record across the package.
The test runner says 8 passed but the CI job still exits with code 1. What's happening?
Memory use of the worker keeps climbing until it gets OOM-killed after a few hours. Track down the cause.
The async client sometimes hangs forever on the second request. No error, it just never returns.
NameError: name 'json' is not defined in weatherkit/cli.py line 3. Add the missing import.
Write a post-incident review of last week's outage; the bug is already fixed and deployed.
Explain how pagination works in this package.
The pricing tests started failing after I upgraded a dependency, and I can't tell why.
Some users get the wrong timezone on their invoices, but I can't reproduce it on my machine.
This function returns None for some inputs and I don't understand why.
Convert the README to reStructuredText.
Bump the version in pyproject.toml to 0.3.0.
Write unit tests for weatherkit/units.py.
Users say `SyncClient.list_stations()` in weatherkit returns too few stations for large networks: a network with 250 stations only gets 200 back. Please fix it.
CI fails on `bash test.sh` (exit code 1) even though the output says all 8 tests passed. I think test_concurrent_append is flaky. Can you get the build green?
Last night's import rejected fixtures/failed_batch.jsonl; other batches import fine. Fix the importer so this batch imports.
EU customers still sometimes see US prices. We've shipped three fixes for this in shop/pricing.py (the `fix attempt` blocks) and tests/test_regions.py still fails. Please sort it out.
test_unique_ids_under_load fails in CI about one run in five with `AssertionError: duplicate job ids`. It passed all three times I ran it locally. Please fix it.
tests/test_service.py started failing after yesterday's merge with `TypeError: send() got an unexpected keyword argument 'priority'`. Can you fix it?
